notes.title: Update (gold coins)
notes.content:
Passing this puzzle to many caused great problems and 90% of the players without a hint could not get through.

We added a little hint that will make it easier to find the right combination.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed a problem with the triangle when the segments did not get up correctly and did not turn.

Sorry! For some reason, not all updates have been downloaded. We fixed, now everything works!

Thank you for your patience and understanding!

notes.content:
